title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): when the implementing seat's Fable is exhausted, it hands the review to triage with a machine-findable marker; triage runs it and the record says so
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed rule. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the triage seat thread, verbatim: 「关于契约复审，开发自己有fable时都可以自己审核，只有开发的fable用完了，才需要分诊，但是此时分诊要能看出来，区别出来。」 This follows the triage seat's options on who owns contract review (lean C, a triage backstop). The maintainer narrowed the backstop to one trigger. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The ruling, as rule text to write

1. **Default unchanged:** the seat that dispatched the work runs the contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`references/contract-review.md`: 「谁跑 = 派发席」).
2. **Hand-off only on an exhausted Fable:** when that seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` call fails for quota (HTTP 429 / quota exhausted), the seat does not review at a lower tier. It hands the review to triage.
3. **Triage must be able to tell the case apart.** The hand-off is one PR comment in a fixed, machine-findable shape, plus the existing `needs:contract-review` label:
   ```
   Contract-review-handoff: triage — CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER unavailable (<HTTP status / error>, <UTC time>) · head <sha>
   ```
   A PR that carries `needs:contract-review` **without** this line is still its own seat's to review, and triage does not touch it.
4. **Triage's act:** each round, triage lists open PRs whose latest hand-off line names the **current head**. For each one, it runs the review in an isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` subagent, with the same-shape record (`## Contract review`, `Served-tier:`, the head sha, ①②③ (and ④ where it applies), PASS/FAIL), and `Reviewed-by:` naming the triage seat. A PASS removes the label, per the existing rule. If triage's own call is also quota-refused, triage writes that once on the PR and leaves the label, ⛔ it never reviews at a lower tier.
6. **Stale-review tracking.** Maintainer, 2026-10-27, after triage missed a moved head on PR #26598: 「改进 skills」. Each round, triage compares every open PR that carries a triage-rendered `## Contract review` record against its current head. If the head has moved past the record's `Head-sha`, that record is stale. The one exception is a move covered by the existing regen-only / prose-only rule, judged on the committed tree.
   - **Triage's own FAIL, head moved:** in the same round, triage re-reviews the new head at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. It checks every earlier must-fix item, and it reviews the delta commits as changes in their own right.
   - **Triage's own PASS, head moved:** triage posts one note on the PR saying the PASS no longer governs and a delta review is owed. That review falls to the PR's own seat, or to triage again if a fresh `Contract-review-handoff:` line appears.
   - **The round record** lists each triage-reviewed PR as `record head → current head → state` (current / stale-FAIL re-reviewed / stale-PASS noted), so a moved head cannot drop out of sight.
   - **The recogniser** in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` exposes the record's `Head-sha` and its `Reviewed-by` session, so the comparison is one read, not prose parsing. ⛔ No gate reads it.
7. **What does not change:** the review grants no landing, enqueue or approval. Tier H still waits on the governed approver. A head that moves after the hand-off needs a new hand-off line (or the seat's own review).

## Where it lands

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (〈复核归属与资格〉: the hand-off arm and the line's shape).
- `references/triage-duties.md` (the round step).
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: recognise the hand-off line, so a seat or patrol reads it the same way. ⛔ No gate reads it.

Tier S (`.claude/**`) plus one `scripts/pm/**` recogniser. `domain:skills`. Within the ratchet headroom: widen existing lines where possible.

## Until it lands

The triage seat already applies points 3–4 by hand to any PR that carries such a line, or an equivalent explicit statement that the dev's Fable was quota-refused (for example #26619's "Fable quota was exhausted (HTTP 429)"). It does not touch reviews a seat is running itself.
